title: Greifeinrichtung für eine Handlingsvorrichtung einer Bearbeitungsmaschine

features.item: A housing with a grip portion designed as a hollow body for gripping
An electrically operated vacuum generating device in the housing
Exhaust air from the vacuum generating device guided through the hollow grip portion to an air outlet
A sound-damping device arranged in the grip portion
A suction plate comprising a carrier plate and a seal fastened to the carrier plate extending around it
features.note: (non-English passage at abstract) The reference discloses a base body (carrier plate) with vacuum suction cups and a sealing element surrounding a suction field, but it does not explicitly state that the seal is fastened to the carrier plate.

features.item: A grip unit with hollow grip portion, electrically operated vacuum generator, exhaust air routed through grip to outlet, and sound-damping device in grip
Vacuum handling apparatus with suction plate and grip unit combined
features.note: (non-English passage at abstract) The reference describes a gripping device for a handling apparatus of a processing machine, specifically for handling plate-shaped workpieces, using vacuum suction cups on a base body.

features.item: Grip portion at least partially lined with sound-damping material
Vacuum generating device arranged completely in a first housing portion
Sound-reducing device in the first housing portion or first housing portion lined with sound-reducing material
Grip portion elongated between first and second housing portions with air outlet on second housing portion
Air collection screw upstream of grip portion in first housing portion for collecting exhaust air
Bent or curved air baffles downstream of grip portion directing exhaust air to air outlet
Battery coupling point on second housing portion with air baffles directing exhaust air away from battery coupling point
Grip unit and suction plate releasably connected via a coupling device
Grip unit with suction opening fluidically connected to suction chamber delimited by suction plate
features.note: (non-English passage at abstract) The reference describes a suction field surrounded by a sealing element that can be subjected to negative pressure for handling a workpiece, implying a fluid connection to a vacuum source, but it does not explicitly mention a 'grip unit with suction opening' or a 'suction chamber delimited by suction plate'.

claims.note: The reference describes a gripping device for a handling apparatus of a processing machine, not specifically a grip unit for a vacuum hand-operated laying device for use with a suction plate.
The reference describes a gripping device with vacuum suction cups on a base body, but does not mention a housing with a grip portion or an electrically operated vacuum generating device.
The reference does not describe a grip portion designed as a hollow body.
The reference does not describe exhaust air being guided through a grip portion to an air outlet.
The reference describes a gripping device for a handling apparatus with vacuum suction cups and a sealing element, but does not mention a sound-damping device arranged in a grip portion.
The reference does not describe a grip portion lined with a sound-damping material.
The reference describes a gripping device with vacuum suction cups and a base body, but does not mention a vacuum generating device arranged completely in a first housing portion.
The reference does not describe a sound-reducing device in a first housing portion or a first housing portion lined with sound-reducing material.

The reference describes a gripping device for handling workpieces with vacuum suction cups and a sealing element, but does not mention a grip unit with an elongated grip portion between first and second housing portions or an air outlet arranged on a second housing portion.
The reference describes a gripping device with vacuum suction cups and a sealing element, but does not mention an air collection device or an air collection screw for collecting exhaust air.
The reference describes a gripping device with vacuum suction cups and a sealing element, but does not mention air baffles for guiding exhaust air.

The reference describes a gripping device for handling workpieces, but does not mention a battery coupling point for an electrical energy storage device or rechargeable battery, nor air baffles for directing exhaust air away from such a point.
The reference does not mention air baffles or directing exhaust air away from a battery coupling point.

(non-English passage at abstract) The reference describes a gripping device for a handling device of a processing machine, specifically for handling plate-shaped workpieces, which is a vacuum handling apparatus.
(non-English passage at abstract) The reference describes a base body (carrier plate) with a holding device that has a sealing element (seal) surrounding a suction field.
(non-English passage at abstract) The reference discloses a gripping device, but the specific details of 'claim 1' of the subject invention are not provided in this reference.
This reference does not disclose a releasable connection between a grip unit and a suction plate via a coupling device.

However, it does not explicitly state that the grip unit has a suction opening fluidically connected to a suction chamber delimited by the suction plate.

overall.why: The reference discloses a gripping device with vacuum suction cups and a sealing element, which aligns well with the core concepts of the subject invention's claims. Many specific features related to the sealing element, its control, and its interaction with the suction cups are explicitly described
